name: SOVA-Bench
paper: SOVA-Bench: Benchmarking the Speech Conversation Ability for LLM-based Voice Assistant

tasks.source_limitations: Contains text question/answer records, not the synthesized speech inputs used by the paper.
The included script evaluates a 500-example test subset and directly calls Groq Whisper; it does not run all four official splits through the Weings API.
The included script runs at most 500 examples and uses a separate STT/LLM chain; the current voice API does not accept simultaneous question text and passage audio in a single turn.
The saved run has 16 successful records for a target of 500; that result is not a reliable full benchmark estimate.

tasks.paper_metric: GPT-evaluated accuracy; answer rate and conditioned accuracy also analyzed
tasks.source_limitations: The app's current SER checkpoint is a public 4-class SUPERB model, while the paper uses a 5-choice IEMOCAP task. The text-only pilot does not measure acoustic emotion recognition. IEMOCAP access/licensing and label mapping must be handled explicitly.

tasks.paper_metric: GPT-evaluated accuracy; answer rate and conditioned accuracy also analyzed
tasks.source_limitations: Included script evaluates a separate pretrained age/gender model on a 500-example sampled subset, not the Weings voice pipeline.

tasks.paper_metric: GPT-evaluated accuracy; answer rate and conditioned accuracy also analyzed
tasks.source_limitations: Included script evaluates a separate pretrained age/gender model with custom age-bin mapping; the mapping must be checked against paper labels before comparison.

tasks.paper_metric: Consistency WER, GPTScore semantic quality, UTMOSv2 acoustic quality
tasks.source_limitations: The zip's generation run has 20 custom prompts. Its C/R/H/I Likert judge is a custom rubric, not proven to be the exact GPTScore implementation in the paper.

strict_reproduction_note: The supplied paper names metrics and dataset counts but does not fully specify all judge prompts, normalization details, model settings, and label transformations in the five-page version. Full numerical reproduction therefore requires the authors' exact protocol/code or a declared compatible protocol.
